reason: I always check reviews and ratings before I book anyone, and this app has none yet that I can see -- a verified ID badge on the freelancer isn't the same as other customers vouching for them in Tamil.
objection: I don't trust giving payment details to a new app I've never heard of, with no track record and nobody in my building's WhatsApp group using it yet.
would_change_my_mind: If a couple of neighbours in my apartment WhatsApp group actually used it and said it worked, or if I could see real customer reviews and ratings in Tamil before paying anything.
